ValidationRule.description: The Pending Reason 'Internal Response' or 'Supervisor' needs to be selected for Status 'Internal - On Hold'. Created separate rule for CAC Executive Escalations as Contact, Account & Customer ID are required. For ref, check user story #27296 on Gitlab.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.Name = 'CAC Executive Escalations', ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Internal - On Hold'), AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(NAS_Pending_Reason__c, 'Internal Response')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(NAS_Pending_Reason__c, 'Supervisor')) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To change the case status to 'Internal - On Hold', the Pending Reason must be either 'Internal Response' or 'Supervisor'.
